dataset: Symptom crosswalk proposal — SCHEMA ONLY, no records yet
purpose: Defines the shape of a proposal that maps existing free-text symptom strings onto future sym.* concepts. Batch A ships the schema; the proposals themselves are produced later by a Codex-built tool and reviewed by a human.
policy: possible_id is ALWAYS null in this file. Ids are minted only after the vocabulary, template and validator are approved and a human has reviewed the proposal — never by the tool that generates it.
This is a proposal, never canon. Nothing here may appear in a relation field (D11: import layers are not namespaces).
source_text is preserved verbatim. A decomposition proposal never replaces or edits its source — pattern.key_signs_zh keeps its 182 strings regardless of what is proposed here (§0 只加深不刪除).

match_layer exists because the three layers have completely different reliability. L1 is mechanical; L2 needs confirmation; L3 is a per-item clinical judgement and CANNOT be automated. Mixing them in one list hides which rows are safe to batch.

Measured 2026-08-06: naive 2+2 splitting of the 112 four-character key_signs produces 192 atoms — MORE than the 182 inputs — and yields garbage like 面色+萎黃 and 痰易+咯出. Under a strict test (both halves independently attested as standalone keys) only 3 are certainly decomposable: 口苦咽乾, 心悸健忘, 心悸失眠. The other 109 need a human.

field_definitions.source_text: verbatim string as it appears in the source layer
field_definitions.source_record_ids: which records carry this string — without it a bad decomposition cannot be traced back to the patterns it would affect
field_definitions.proposal_type: exact | alias | compound | location_variant | not_a_symptom | already_exists
field_definitions.proposed_concepts: one entry per resulting concept; possible_id stays null
field_definitions.needs_human_review: true for every L3 row without exception
field_definitions.reviewer_note: why a proposal was rejected — without it the next pass re-proposes the same wrong split

expected_volumes_measured_2026_08_06.L2_alias: 10 by containment today; 25-40 once an alias table exists
expected_volumes_measured_2026_08_06.location_variant: 44 pain entries collapsing to ~15 base symptoms
